plan.summary: FEATURE B rework: add a BATCH message-status client method (GetMessageStatusesAsync — instanceID + messageIDs[] up to 100) parsing the CONFIRMED-LIVE response shape data.messages[] (found + messageStatus), and switch the ProjectsService status-pull caller to group pending wamids by resolved instance, chunk ≤100, and apply per-message via the existing idempotent monotonic ApplyDeliveryStatusAsync. Fixes a confirmed defect: the singular ExtractMessageStatus parsed a top-level data.messageStatus that the live endpoint never returns (it nests under data.messages[]), so 'Durumu Yenile' never applied anything.

(2) Q FEATURE C'yi DURAKLAT dedi (plan 20260612-cxapi-stranded-sending-recovery.json PLANNING'de bekliyor). KARARLAR: (a) request body {instanceID, messageIDs:[...]} JsonPropertyName 'messageIDs'; (b) response data.messages[] typed DTO ile parse (JsonOptions PropertyNameCaseInsensitive=true zaten açık) — found+messageStatus(0..5 nullable); (c) 626 (status:false) = 'hiçbiri bulunamadı' → Ok=true boş liste (HATA DEĞİL, graceful no-op); 506/404 vb. status:false → Ok=false error; (d) caller resolved-instance'a göre grupla (row.InstanceId ?? defaultInstanceId), ≤100 chunk, MapStatus + ApplyDeliveryStatusAsync DEĞİŞMEZ; (e) MapStatus aynı (1=sent,2=delivered,3=read,4=failed; 0=Pending/5=Deleted→null ignore); (f) yeni error code GEREKMEZ (mevcut INV-OB-094/095 caller'da).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: New WapCrmSendClient.GetMessageStatusesAsync(int instanceId, IReadOnlyList<string> messageIds, string secret, int tenantId) POSTs {instanceID, messageIDs:[...]} (JsonPropertyName 'messageIDs'), attaches X-CIB-SecretKey per-request, bounded by the same linked-CTS timeout + finite backstop as the send. Guards: empty list and >100 throw ArgumentException/ArgumentOutOfRangeException; instanceId<=0 and blank secret throw.

Response parse reads the live shape: envelope WapCrmApiResponse<JsonElement>; status==true → deserialize data into {messages:[{messageID,found,messageStatus}]} (typed, case-insensitive). Returns WapCrmBatchStatusResult{Ok=true, Messages=[entries]}. found:false / null messageStatus entries are carried as found=false/null (caller skips), never applied as a status.

status:false with statusCode '626' → Ok=true with an EMPTY Messages list (graceful 'none found', not an error). Any other status:false (e.g. 506/404) or non-success HTTP or unparseable body → Ok=false with a short non-secret Error. Timeout/transport → Ok=false (mirror singular), secret never logged.

ProjectsService.RefreshRunStatusAsync groups pending wamids by resolved instanceId (row.InstanceId ?? defaultInstanceId; skip <=0), chunks ≤100, calls the batch method, and for each found entry with a non-null status applies WapCrmAckMapping.MapStatus via ApplyDeliveryStatusAsync (idempotent monotonic, UNCHANGED). checked = wamids queried, updated = applied; rollup recomputed only when updated>0. CxapiSend allowlist gate unchanged. Full solution builds clean (Shared changed → full build).

verification_questions.question: Does the batch parse correctly read the live shape data.messages[] (found + messageStatus 0..5), and does a found:false / messageStatus:null entry get skipped rather than wrongly applied as a status?
Is statusCode 626 ('none found') treated as a graceful empty result (Ok=true, no updates) and NOT as an error, while 506/404/transport failures keep the chunk uncounted-as-updated without throwing?

Does grouping pending wamids by resolved instanceId and chunking ≤100 preserve the original per-message idempotent monotonic apply (ApplyDeliveryStatusAsync) and the checked/updated accounting, with the secret never logged and the CxapiSend allowlist gate unchanged?

forbidden_areas: GetMessageStatusAsync (singular) + ExtractMessageStatus — PRESERVED unchanged per Q (kept for backward-compat, no longer consumed)
CxapiSend allowlist gate / InstanceId resolution semantics (row.InstanceId ?? defaultInstanceId)
non_goals: No removal/behaviour-change of the singular status method
No new error code (existing INV-OB-094/095 cover the caller)
No change to StatusPullCap (200) or the SQL pending-set query
No unit tests beyond optional mapper coverage (DB/HTTP-bound; CLAUDE.md: no tests unless requested)
intentional_exclusions: Singular method's now-stale top-level parse left intact (inert; no consumer) rather than fixed, per Q's 'preserve singular' choice
No retry/backoff on the batch status call (best-effort complement to the ack webhook; a failed chunk simply applies nothing and is re-pullable)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Batch fetch failures are best-effort by design (the ack webhook is primary): a transport/timeout/non-626 status:false makes the chunk Ok=false and applies nothing (re-pullable), logged via the client's existing SystemWarn. 626 is an explicit graceful empty (no updates). DB errors on apply/rollup surface INV-OB-095 to the operator (unchanged). The secret is attached per-request, never logged. No path swallows an error silently.
